games.name: PRISON RP
games.desc:
PRISON RP | Realistic Prison Roleplay

Start as an inmate. Climb the ranks, run with a gang, or keep the order as a guard. Every role is played by a real player, and every day behind the walls writes a new story.

- Inmates: work, fish, mine, box at the gym and level up
- Gangs: create or join one, take territories, run contraband past the guards
- Guards and Warden: patrols, roll calls, arrests, fines and lights out
- Medical team: nurses, medics and surgeons treat the injured
- Teachers and psychologist: classes, diplomas and therapy sessions
- A real daily schedule: meals, yard time, classes and curfew

Join your friends in game anytime.
Servers in 16 languages.

Controls
PC: [H] Voice range · [K] Radio · [X] Talk on radio · [B] Emotes
Console: full controller support
Phone and tablet supported
